known_defects: A tracked file reaches the fingerprint only through git's status and diffs, so a change that git does not report leaves the four hashes the same: other line endings in a file that is modified already, with `core.autocrlf=true`; a change of the same size in text that a clean filter drops; or an edit to a file marked with `git update-index --assume-unchanged` (corrected in 0.6.2).

mechanisms.mechanism: An untracked file is recorded by its path and the hash of its contents. Its executable bit is not part of the record, although git commits it: a change of the bit alone leaves the fingerprint the same.
mechanisms.trigger: `chmod +x` on an untracked file between the two fingerprints, on a file system that keeps the bit.
mechanisms.why_severity: A missing guard with a narrow effect: the mode of a new file.
